$comment: Shipped defaults. Your copy lives at ~/.laconia/config.json and is re-read every turn, so edits take effect without a restart. Anything you omit falls back to this file.
$mode: block = reject a violating reply and rewrite it before it is shown. advisory = log only, never interrupt. off = disable the gate (the voice contract stays on).
$blockRules: Only mechanically unambiguous rules belong here. Judgment rules like length and altitude stay advisory and are carried by the voice contract instead.

circuitBreaker.$comment: After this many blocks in one session, Laconia downgrades itself to advisory for the rest of it and says so once. A bad rule cannot become a loop of nagging.

browserFirst.$comment: Off by default because it is a strong opinion, not a writing rule. Turn it on if you want agents pushed to a real browser (Playwright MCP, Claude in Chrome) instead of WebFetch, whose output is a small model's summary of a stripped page and fails quietly. Claude Code only: Codex web search is a hosted tool that hooks cannot intercept.

ledger.$comment: One JSONL line per turn-ending reply at ~/.laconia/ledger.jsonl. Local only, never uploaded. This is what `laconia report` reads.
